title: Why he had no cornet or teacher
summary: Willard asks why he started on banjo; Davison says he had no horn, no money and no one in town to teach wind instruments.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: But, you still seem to play the banjo at that point--
the thing that's interesting is why do you think you didn't play-- start in trying to play the cornet right away.

First of all, I didn't have one and my folks had no money to buy me one and then, on the other hand, there was nobody in my home town to teach wind instruments.There was a couple of players that were in the Elks Marching Band in a small town - a very small band - maybe twelve pieces of players - you know - and they didn't want to be bothered teaching any kids anything. They weren't legitimate teachers.
